reasoningChain.evidence: I want to keep progressing and learn whether the newly rescued character is useful.
The mage was just unlocked but did not automatically join the active team, so it has no combat evidence yet.
The reserve mage is described as a complete damage hero, while the barricade militia ranked fourth in damage in both observed battles and is currently judged a little weak.
I can replace the barricade militia with the mage without spending a visible resource.
This preserves the proven warrior, the healer, and the already confirmed drummer experiment while replacing the active member with the weakest repeated contribution.
If the complete mage is a useful upgrade over the barricade militia, it should rank among the top two damage contributors in the next combat.

hypothesis.problem: The team depends heavily on the warrior for damage and the barricade militia has contributed very little damage.
hypothesis.cause: The newly rescued complete mage may add more reliable damage than the incomplete barricade militia.
